profile.headline: Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary: Chantal is an associate software engineer with professional and scholastic experiences in software and hardware engineering. Additionally, she possess experience in the full lifecycle of Software Development that includes: Requirements Gathering and Analysis for stakeholders, Data Analysis, Implementation of enhancements and bug fixes, Unit and Functional Testing, and Production Support. Chantal quickly learns and masters new technologies, is successful in both team-based and self-directed environments, strives to exceed expectations, and is capable of handling multiple task with conflicting deadlines. Chantal Thomas is currently enrolled in a Master of Art in Digital Media Design at Harvard University Extension School which encompasses Web Development and Digital Marketing.

	Delegated tasks to members of the chapter in order to promote fairness and to obtain a team work environment

	Reduced expenditure and increased fundraising which overall increased the chapter’s budget in comparison to the previous year

	Rigorously abided by the sorority’s founding documents
